summary: Robbery-murder case with ice picks; eye witness accounts corroborated; Test Identification Parade refusal by appellant; recovery of weapon at instance of accused; co-accused identified in TIP but appellant not identified; High Court affirmed conviction under IPC ss.302/392/394/397r/w34; prosecution evidence held reliable; appeals dismissed by High Court upheld; no material contradictions in testimony.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; conviction and life sentence upheld.
